methods.name: chooseKind
methods.body: const kinds=["flipper","pulsar","tanker","spiker","fuseball"];const allowed={flipper:w.flippers,pulsar:w.pulsars,tanker:w.tankers,spiker:w.spikers,fuseball:w.fuseballs};const count=k=>foes.filter(f=>f.kind==k).length;const room={flipper:0,pulsar:0,tanker:0,spiker:0,fuseball:0};for(const k of kinds)room[k]=Math.max(0,allowed[k].max-count(k));for(const f of foes)if(f.kind=="tanker")room[f.cargo]=room[f.cargo]>=2?room[f.cargo]-2:room[f.cargo]+254;for(const k of kinds)room[k]=Math.min(room[k],Math.max(0,this.maxFoes-foes.length));const launch=k=>{if(k!="tanker")return{kind:k,cargo:"flipper"};const r=rnd(4);for(let n=1;n<=4;n++){const c=w.cargo[(r+4-n)%4];if(room[c]>0)return{kind:k,cargo:c}}return null};const first=ks=>{for(const k of ks){const l=launch(k);if(l!=null)return l}return null};const open=kinds.filter(k=>room[k]>0);if(open.length==0)return null;const lastFirst=[...kinds].reverse();if(open.length==1)return first(lastFirst.filter(k=>room[k]>0&&allowed[k].min>0));const below=first(lastFirst.filter(k=>room[k]>0&&count(k)<allowed[k].min));if(below!=null)return below;if(room.spiker>0&&room.tanker>0){const l=launch(this.spikeIn(lane,t)>.16?"tanker":"spiker");if(l!=null)return l}const from=1+rnd(4);return first([0,1,2,3,4].map(n=>kinds[mod(from-n,5)]).filter(k=>allowed[k].min>0&&room[k]>0))

methods.name: step
methods.body: const v=this.value;let points=0;let caught=false;const sounds=[];const goneFoes=new Set,goneShots=new Set,goneFoeShots=new Set;const spikeH=new Map;const edits=[];const born=[];const fired=[];const blasts=[];const playing=alive&&clawDepth>=1;const hitFoe=(f,d,shot)=>{goneFoes.add(f.id);const worth=shot?this.points(f.kind,d):0;points+=worth;sounds.push("explosion");blasts.push(f.kind=="fuseball"&&shot?["points",this.laneNow(f,t),d,worth]:["burst",this.laneNow(f,t),d,0]);if(f.kind=="tanker"){for(const side of[-1,1]){let l=f.lane+side;if(!closed&&(l<0||l>15))continue;l=mod(l,16);const s=this.surface(l,t,w,{kind:f.cargo,cargo:"flipper"});born.push({...s,from:f.lane,flipAt:t,born:t-Math.min(d,.84)/s.speed,dir:side,next:t+s.flipFor})}}};const surfaced=new Set;let held=!playing||v.foes.length>=this.maxFoes;if(!held){const inTube=v.foes.slice();for(const n of v.nymphs.filter(n2=>n2.due<=this.risen).sort((a,b)=>a.due-b.due)){const l=inTube.length<this.maxFoes?this.chooseKind(n.lane,inTube,w,t):null;if(l==null){held=true;break}const f=this.surface(n.lane,t,w,l);born.push(f);inTube.push(f);surfaced.add(n.id)}}if(!held)this.risen=this.risen+dt;if(playing){for(let i=0;i<v.foes.length;i++){const f=v.foes[i];if(f.kind!="flipper"||t<f.next||this.flipOf(f,t)<1)continue;for(const[field,value]of this.flipperMove(f,t,clawLane,closed,w))edits.push([i,field,value])}}for(const s of v.shots){const d=this.shotDepth(s,t);const back=d+this.shotSpeed*dt+.03;if(d<=0){goneShots.add(s.id);continue}const fs=v.foeShots.find(e=>!goneFoeShots.has(e.id)&&e.lane==s.lane&&this.foeShotDepth(e,t)>=d-.05&&this.foeShotDepth(e,t)<=back);if(fs!=null){goneShots.add(s.id);goneFoeShots.add(fs.id);blasts.push(["burst",s.lane,d,0]);continue}const f=v.foes.find(e=>!goneFoes.has(e.id)&&this.laneNow(e,t)==s.lane&&this.depthOf(e,t)>=d-.05&&this.depthOf(e,t)<=back);if(f!=null){goneShots.add(s.id);hitFoe(f,this.depthOf(f,t),true);continue}const k=v.spikes.findIndex(p=>p.lane==s.lane);if(k>=0){const h=spikeH.get(k)??this.spikeHeight(v.spikes[k],t);if(h>.01&&d<=h){goneShots.add(s.id);spikeH.set(k,Math.max(0,h-.07));points+=3;sounds.push("spikeHit")}}}for(const s of v.foeShots){if(goneFoeShots.has(s.id))continue;if(this.foeShotDepth(s,t)>=1){goneFoeShots.add(s.id);if(alive&&s.lane==clawLane&&clawDepth>=1)caught=true}}for(let i=0;i<v.foes.length;i++){const f=v.foes[i];if(goneFoes.has(f.id))continue;const d=this.depthOf(f,t);const settled=this.flipOf(f,t)>=1;if(f.kind=="tanker"&&d>=1)hitFoe(f,1,false);else if(f.kind=="spiker"){const run=(t-f.born)*f.speed;const k=v.spikes.findIndex(p=>p.lane==f.lane);const turning=run>=f.top&&run-f.speed*dt<f.top;if(turning&&k>=0&&v.spikes[k].h<f.top&&!spikeH.has(k))spikeH.set(k,f.top);if(run>=2*f.top){if(v.nymphs.length==0)edits.push([i,"kind","tanker"],[i,"cargo","flipper"],[i,"born",t],[i,"speed",w.speed]);else{const l=this.shortestSpike();edits.push([i,"lane",l],[i,"from",l],[i,"born",t])}}}else if(alive&&clawDepth>=1&&settled&&f.lane==clawLane){if((f.kind=="flipper"||f.kind=="fuseball")&&d>=1)caught=true;if(f.kind=="pulsar"&&this.pulseAt(t)&&d>=.5)caught=true}}if(alive&&clawDepth<1){for(const sp of v.spikes)if(sp.lane==clawLane&&(spikeH.get(v.spikes.indexOf(sp))??this.spikeHeight(sp,t))>=clawDepth)caught=true}if(playing&&!caught){const odds=[1,32/256,16/256,6/256,1/256];let up=v.foeShots.length-goneFoeShots.size;for(let i=0;i<v.foes.length&&up<w.shots;i++){const f=v.foes[i];const fires=f.kind=="flipper"||f.kind=="tanker"||f.kind=="spiker"||f.kind=="pulsar"&&w.pulsarsFire;if(!fires||goneFoes.has(f.id)||t<f.fireAt||this.flipOf(f,t)<1)continue;const d=this.depthOf(f,t);if(d>.857||Math.random()>=1-Math.pow(1-odds[up],dt/this.frame))continue;fired.push({id:this.newId(),lane:f.lane,from:d,firedAt:t});edits.push([i,"fireAt",t+w.fireDelay]);sounds.push("enemyShot");up=up+1}}for(const[k,h]of spikeH)this.set(["spikes",k,"h"],h);for(const[i,field,value]of edits)this.set(["foes",i,field],value);for(const l of edits.filter(e=>e[1]=="lane"&&v.foes[e[0]].kind=="spiker"))this.ensureSpike(l[2]);this.removeWhere("nymphs",surfaced);this.removeWhere("foes",goneFoes);this.removeWhere("shots",goneShots);this.removeWhere("foeShots",goneFoeShots);this.removeWhere("blasts",new Set(v.blasts.filter(b=>t-b.at>this.blastLife*(b.kind=="points"?3:1)).map(b=>b.id)));for(const f of born){this.set(["foes","-"],f);if(f.kind=="spiker")this.ensureSpike(f.lane)}for(const s of fired)this.set(["foeShots","-"],s);for(const[kind,lane,depth,worth]of blasts)this.blast(kind,lane,depth,t,worth);return{points,caught,sounds}

methods.name: zap
methods.body: const foes=this.value.foes;if(foes.length==0)return 0;const hit=all?foes:[foes[rnd(foes.length)]];let points=0;for(const f of hit){const d=this.depthOf(f,t);points+=this.points(f.kind,d);this.blast("burst",this.laneNow(f,t),d,t,0)}this.removeWhere("foes",new Set(hit.map(f=>f.id)));return points

methods.name: draw
methods.body: const tube=this.root.tube;const n=tube.rim.length;const near=tube.nearDepth();if(n==0||near<=0)return;const ink=this.$provided("theme").web;d.lineWidth=1.6;d.lineJoin="round";d.shadowBlur=6;d.strokeStyle=ink;d.shadowColor=ink;d.beginPath();for(const depth of[0,near]){for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const p=tube.corner(i,depth);if(i==0)d.moveTo(p.x,p.y);else d.lineTo(p.x,p.y)}if(tube.closed)d.closePath()}for(let i=0;i<n;i++){const a=tube.corner(i,0),b=tube.corner(i,near);d.moveTo(a.x,a.y);d.lineTo(b.x,b.y)}d.stroke();if(this.lit<0)return;const glow=this.$provided("theme").claw;d.strokeStyle=glow;d.shadowColor=glow;d.lineWidth=2;d.beginPath();const a0=tube.corner(this.lit,0),a1=tube.corner(this.lit,near);const b0=tube.corner(this.lit+1,0),b1=tube.corner(this.lit+1,near);d.moveTo(a0.x,a0.y);d.lineTo(a1.x,a1.y);d.lineTo(b1.x,b1.y);d.lineTo(b0.x,b0.y);d.stroke()

methods.name: place
methods.body: const s=this.size,g=this.gap,m=this.margin;const left=this.root.safeLeft,right=this.root.width-this.root.safeRight,bottom=this.root.height-this.root.safeBottom;const out=[];const one=(id,label,icon,x,y,w,h)=>out.push({id,label,icon,x:Math.round(x),y:Math.round(y),w,h,faint:this.fit=="over"&&id!="start"});if(this.startShown){const sw=Math.round(2.4*s),sh=Math.round(.75*s);if(this.fit=="beside")one("start","START","",(left+this.fieldX-sw)/2,bottom-m-sh,sw,sh);else if(this.fieldY+this.fieldH+m+sh+m<=bottom)one("start","START","",this.middle-sw/2,this.fieldY+this.fieldH+m,sw,sh);else if(this.startOverLeft){const nw=Math.round(Math.max(1.5*s,Math.min(sw,this.fieldX-left-2*m)));one("start","START","",Math.max(left+m/2,(left+this.fieldX-nw)/2),bottom-m-sh,nw,sh)}else one("start","START","",this.middle-sw/2,bottom-m-sh,sw,sh);return out}const lw=this.extent("left","col"),lh=this.extent("left","row");const rw=this.extent("right","col"),rh=this.extent("right","row");const cw=this.extent("center","col"),ch=this.extent("center","row");const put=(side,x0,y0)=>{for(const k of this.keys.filter(k2=>k2.side==side))one(k.id,k.label,k.icon??"",x0+k.col*(s+g),y0+k.row*(s+g),s,s)};if(this.fit=="beside"){const lmid=(left+this.fieldX)/2,rmid=(this.fieldX+this.fieldW+right)/2;put("left",lmid-lw/2,bottom-m-lh);put("right",rmid-rw/2,bottom-m-rh);put("center",rmid-cw/2,bottom-m-rh-g-ch)}else{put("left",left+m,bottom-m-lh);put("right",right-m-rw,bottom-m-rh);put("center",(left+right-cw)/2,bottom-m-ch-(this.centerRaised?Math.max(lh,rh)+g:0))}return out

methods.name: place
methods.body: const axis=this.axis;const size=axis=="x"?"width":"height";const kids=this.laid();const flexing=c=>c.flexes===true;let each=0;let flexN=0;for(const c of kids)if(c.visible&&flexing(c))flexN=flexN+1;if(flexN>0){let content=0;let visN=0;for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;visN=visN+1;if(!flexing(c))content=content+c.footprint()[size]}const extent=this.contentExtent(size);each=Math.max(0,(extent-content-this.spacing*Math.max(0,visN-1))/flexN)}const al=this.align;const cross=axis=="x"?"y":"x";const crossSize=axis=="x"?"height":"width";const crossOf=c=>{if(flexing(c))return{lead:0,extent:c[crossSize]};const fc=c.footprint();return{lead:axis=="x"?fc.y:fc.x,extent:fc[crossSize]}};let line=0;let lineBase=0;if(al!="none"){if(al=="baseline"&&axis!="x")this.refuseStackBaseline();for(const c of kids){if(!c.visible)continue;line=Math.max(line,crossOf(c).extent);const b=c.baseline;if(al=="baseline"&&typeof b=="number")lineBase=Math.max(lineBase,b)}if(al=="center"||al=="end")line=Math.max(line,this.viewExtent(crossSize))}let pos=0;return kids.map(c=>{const flex=c.visible&&flexing(c);const f=flex?null:c.footprint();const lead=f==null?0:axis=="x"?f.x:f.y;const box=axis=="x"?{x:pos-lead}:{y:pos-lead};if(flex)box[axis=="x"?"w":"h"]=each;if(al!="none"){const co=crossOf(c);const leadC=co.lead;let off=0;if(al=="center")off=(line-co.extent)/2;else if(al=="end")off=line-co.extent;else if(al=="baseline"&&axis=="x"){const b=c.baseline;if(typeof b=="number")off=lineBase-b;else if(c.visible)this.refuseBaseline(c)}box[cross]=off-(al=="baseline"?0:leadC)}if(c.visible)pos=pos+(flex?each:f[size])+this.spacing;return box})
